note: Curated by-memory watchlist of well-known research-misconduct cases (as of training cutoff Jan 2026). Every entry is a matter of PUBLIC RECORD — retracted papers, ORI findings, DOJ settlements, or high-profile academic investigations. This is a targeting seed, not a fraud finding. All leads still require independent evidence review.
